Pratikshya (Swarna x IR64  (* parental line(s) from IRRI germplasm)) - rice variety factsheet.
Product profile: Pratikshya, released in 2006 after being developed by OUAT, Odisha, is suitable for late-sown conditions for rainfed medium land, featuring late maturity and semi-dwarf stature with medium slender grains. Specifically recommended for late-sown conditions in rainfed medium lands, it demonstrates moderate resistance to brown spot, sheath rot, sheath blight, leaf folder, and white-backed plant hopper, while being resistant to gall midge and stem borer.
Priority market segment: TMeLS/R.
Planting method and ecosystem suitability (PTR = puddled transplanted rice, DSR = direct seeded rice): PTR: Recommended; DSR: Not Recommended; Irrigated Lowland: Not Recommended; Rainfed Lowland: Recommended; Upland: Not Recommended.

Pratikshya - key strengths, considerations and positioning.
Key strengths: Good yield; Medium height; profuse tillering; Submergence tolerance; Late maturity; short bold grain; High HRR; excellent eating quality; Resistant to leaf blight.
Considerations: Susceptible to leaf blast, sheath blight, and false smut; Susceptible to BPH, stem borer and gall midge; Loss of golden hull color as is in Swarna.
Positioning (variety replaced / companion, by ecosystem): Replace - Irrigated Lowland: None; Rainfed Lowland: Ranidhan; Upland: None. Companion - Irrigated Lowland: None; Rainfed Lowland: CR-800; Upland: None.

Pratikshya - grain yield, agronomic traits and grain shape (HRR = head rice recovery; grain shape SB = short bold, MS = medium slender, SM = short medium, LB = long bold, MB = medium bold).
Pratikshya -> Grain yield (kg/ha): 5000-5500; Maturity (days): 135-140; Plant height (cm): 100-105; Lodging: Tolerant; HRR %: 67; 1000-grain wt (g): 30; Grain shape: MS.
Ranidhan -> Grain yield (kg/ha): 5000-5500; Maturity (days): 130-135; Plant height (cm): 105-110; Lodging: Susceptible; HRR %: 47; 1000-grain wt (g): 22; Grain shape: MB.

Pratikshya - biotic and abiotic stress reaction (disease and pest tolerance; BPH = brown plant hopper, RTV = rice tungro virus).
Pratikshya -> Leaf blast: Susceptible; Leaf blight: Resistant; Sheath blight: Susceptible; BPH: Susceptible; Gall midge: Resistant; Submergence: Tolerant.
Ranidhan -> Leaf blast: Susceptible; Leaf blight: Resistant; Sheath blight: Susceptible; BPH: Susceptible; Gall midge: Susceptible; Submergence: Susceptible.

Pratikshya - producibility and recommendation.
Producibility: Pratikshya = 2000-2200 Kgs./acre.
Recommendation: Released for cultivation in Odisha, Madhya Pradesh, Andhra Pradesh, West Bengal, and Assam. National check in advanced varietal trial (late) conducted by IIRR, India.
Source note: the factsheet's product-profile prose and its biotic/abiotic stress table differ on some disease ratings (e.g. sheath blight); both are reproduced here exactly as printed on the source.
